name: Supabase
line: Postgres, auth, file storage and functions in one hosted backend.

free.text: 500 MB database per project; may pause after 7 idle days

sql.math: $25 base + the higher of (730 hours × $0.01344 an hour − $10) or $0 + $0 extra egress = $25 a month. The Free plan fails the 500 MB limit.
Pro cannot pause. 730 hours of Micro stay allocated, so the total is $25 + $0 for included disk.

files.math: $25 base + $0 for allowance charges. Requests and minimums are not published.

jobs.math: The 0.5 GB worker is more than the 256 MB limit, and there is no matching job price.
